create_LevelStore: create a LevelStore instance with an optional max_size and data_info dictionary for numpy level data
insert_levels: insert one or more levels into the LevelStore and receive their assigned seed indices
remove_levels: remove one or more levels from the LevelStore by their seed indices
get_level_by_seed: retrieve a stored level by its seed, optionally deserialized as a numpy array
reconcile_seeds: reconcile the LevelStore seeds by ejecting any seeds not present in the provided list
